bias.zh: 反弹 · 抛物线 SAR 翻多，测试 $398.5

read.en: Tesla rose 1.7% on Nov 12 to $397.45, trading $385.20–401.22. It is above the 5-day ($380.9), 10-day ($383.5), 30-day ($380.7), 100-day ($366.4) and 200-day ($382.9); only the 30-day is rising. MACD has been below its signal since Nov 5, above zero, histogram nearly closed (a cross up is close); Parabolic SAR flipped bullish on Nov 12 ($338.15), and RSI is 56.5.
read.zh: 特斯拉 11月12日上涨 1.7%，收于 $397.45，盘中区间 $385.20–401.22。股价位于 5 日（$380.9）、10 日（$383.5）、30 日（$380.7）、100 日（$366.4）和 200 日均线（$382.9）上方；仅 30 日均线在上行。MACD 自 11月5日起位于信号线下方，在零轴上方，柱状图接近收拢（临近上穿）；抛物线 SAR 于 11月12日翻为看多（$338.15），RSI 为 56.5。

read.en: Parabolic SAR turned bullish and the $401.22 high poked above the $396.5–398.5 Nov 3 low and close, but the close stayed inside that band. Resistance is $398.5–401.2, then $403.8–406.5 (Nov 2 close, Nov 3 high) and $414.2 (Nov 2 high). Support is $385.2–388.6, then $382.9–383.5 (200 and 10-day) and $379.8–380.9 (30 and 5-day). A close above $401.2 would target $404–406.5; below $385.2, $383.

s.en: $388 cap since March, cleared; Oct 9 high $388.56; Nov 11–12 lows ($385.2–386.4)
